selection_reasoning: This forms a coherent multi-hop chain based on Minecraft crafting/trading logic. Allium can be crafted into Pink Dye, and hay_block (made of wheat) relates to farming/trading contexts. Both 'mine allium' and 'mine hay_block' are prerequisite gathering tasks. In Minecraft, allium produces Pink Dye when crafted, and red dye can be obtained from other flowers/items. The sell tasks depend on having the dyes available. The structure creates two parallel gathering branches that lead to two selling tasks. Mining allium is needed to eventually sell Pink Dye (allium → pink dye → sell), and mining hay_block provides context for the trading village where Red Dye can also be sold. Both sell tasks require finding a merchant/villager, creating a natural convergence point where the player must locate the trading entity after gathering materials.

edges.reason: Allium is crafted into Pink Dye which is then sold to a villager
Hay block area leads player toward the trading villager needed to sell Red Dye
Selling Red Dye first locates the shepherd villager, then Pink Dye is sold to same villager

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when the player breaks an allium flower block, it drops an 'allium' item that enters their inventory. The player starts with no allium in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms they mined one.

Uses inventory_has because hay bales drop themselves as 'hay_block' items when mined (no tool required, just slow by hand). The player starts with no hay_block in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms they mined one.

Uses inventory_has for emerald because the player starts with 0 emeralds and gains 1 emerald by trading 1 red dye to the shepherd villager. Having ≥1 emerald confirms at least one successful sale occurred. The shepherd at (~8,1,0) has a custom trade: 1 red_dye → 1 emerald.

Uses inventory_has for emerald with min_count=2 because the player gains a second emerald by trading 1 pink dye to the shepherd villager. Requiring ≥2 emeralds inherently enforces that sell Red Dye (which provides the first emerald) was completed before this milestone can trigger. The shepherd has a custom trade: 1 pink_dye → 1 emerald.

scene_description: A compact scene on a 21x21 grass platform featuring: (1) three allium flowers at ~3,0,3 / ~4,0,4 / ~3,0,5 for mining, (2) a hay block stack at ~-4/-5 area (6 blocks, some stacked 2-high) for mining, (3) a shepherd villager in an open oak stall at ~8,1,0 with custom trades buying 1 red dye and 1 pink dye for emeralds each, (4) player starts with 12 red dye, 12 pink dye, and a crafting table.
task_text: Mine an allium flower and a hay block, then sell Red Dye and Pink Dye to the shepherd villager in the stall.
design_notes: Allium flowers at +3/+4/+5 Z direction (~5 blocks from spawn), hay blocks at -4/-5 direction (~6 blocks from spawn), villager stall at +7 to +9 X (~8 blocks from spawn). Player given 12 red dye, 12 pink dye, and crafting table. Trades require only 1 dye each. NoAI keeps villager stationary. Scene radius ~10 blocks. All elements verified accessible across 3 sandbox preview runs.
